summary: New box Part. Pass.: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (Jan 2.33/5461)

data.turoyo: Ǧan: Yaʕni huwwe ḥaṣe kibo yo?
data.translation: Jan: So he has his back bent?

rationale: New Detransitive Part. Pass. state predicate with an overt copula and body-part subject. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation; meaning is established from the Turoyo.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (Jan 2.33/5462)

data.turoyo: Xori Brahim: Huwwe kuyab wo d qubzinawo.
data.translation: Father Brahim: He used to bend over so that we could jump.

rationale: Adds active Infectum-wa with source-separated wo and explicit purpose of letting others jump. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation; meaning is established from the Turoyo.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (Jan 2.33/5464)

data.turoyo: Xori Brahim: E ʕal ḥa bəlḥuḏe. I naqqayo ḥa bəlḥuḏe kab wo. U ḥa d qaṣ wo, kiyab wo huwwe.
data.translation: Father Brahim: Yes, over just one. At that time just one person used to bend over. And the one who was out, it was he who would bend over.

rationale: Thin new cell; one passage shows both reduced kab wo and kiyab wo with a game participant. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation; meaning is established from the Turoyo.

summary: New sense 1: gebeugt sein (Detrans.);
rationale: Kibo yo predicates a bent state of the back, distinct in form from active kəble. The related kyf 1 entry independently has Detransitive Part. Pass.; no eventive Detransitive paradigm is invented.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (JTM 1.1/27)

data.turoyo: məd hawyo i danoke kmawfəqinala bas sale w mas sale, kətla dukṯo xuṣuṣi kmaʕ... kkaybinala tamo.
data.translation: Wenn er zu aufgequollenen Körnern geworden ist, dann nehmen wir ihn heraus und geben ihn in die Körbe, und aus den Körben ... Es gibt eine bestimmte Stelle dafür, wo wir ihn auskippen.

rationale: Thin I.1 Infectum cell; contents-object extension with explicit grain context.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (PrS 18/30)

data.translation: Da beugte er sich vorwärts, um ihn zu packen und herauszuziehen.

rationale: Thin I.1 Preterit cell; objectless bending and purpose.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (PrS 70/19)

data.turoyo: Azzən ḥzalle gubo naʕimo, kibe maye, kəble lu dewo, lo maṭi d mawfəq maye bi kəmmayḏe.
data.translation: Im Weitergehen erblickten sie eine kleine Cisterne, worin Wasser war. Der Wolf bückte sich; konnte aber nicht hinlangen, um mit seiner Mütze Wasser herauszuholen,

rationale: Thin I.1 Preterit cell; overt l-marked wolf agent and no body-part object.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (PrS 70/20)

data.turoyo: Omər: "Lə kməṭeno", — məlle lu səsyo. Kəble lu səsyo lam maye.
data.translation: und sagte zum Pferd, er könne es nicht erreichen. Da bückte sich das Pferd zum Wasser hinunter;

rationale: Thin I.1 Preterit cell; l-marked horse agent and l-direction to water.

summary: ʕal ḥasox → ʕal ḥaṣox
rationale: The identical command in kyb.I.t.imperativ.1 has ḥaṣox; supplied 27/67 has ḥaṣux. Correct s to ṣ, retaining the entry vowel.

summary: New idiom: kəble/koyəb qarʕo '(fig.) aus Scham den Kopf senken'

data.headword: kəble/koyəb qarʕo '(fig.) aus Scham den Kopf senken'
data.turoyo: d howe qarʕe du gawro ʕeloyo w d lo koyəb qarʕe w d lo foyəš mnakfo.
data.translation: damit das Haupt des Gatten erhoben bleibt und er es nieht zu beugen braucht und nicht beschämt dasteht.

rationale: Explicit shame mnakfo and elevated/lowered head opposition. Allowed full lookup of kyf 1 confirms a parallel example at 107/19 but no listed idiom. One example only.

summary: L-agent Preterit occurs with a body-part object and with objectless posture. German sich bücken does not establish Detransitive morphology.
The inherited kyb/kyf cross-reference remains unresolved. Full allowed lookup of kyf 1 confirms posture and humiliation parallels but supplies no III makəb.
The head-lowering example cooccurs with mnakfo; it is a figurative collocation, without a new numbered posture sense.
Jan adds active Infectum-wa with separately written wo; source spacing in kuyab wo, kab wo and kiyab wo is preserved. The ordinary bending meaning does not split by game or greeting context.
Kibo yo at Jan 2.33/5461 describes the bent back. A new Detransitive state sense is paired only with the attested Part. Pass.; no forced bending event or external agent is asserted.
Allowed lookup of kyf 1 confirms Detransitive Part. Pass. kəfto. This supports comparison but does not justify merging the roots or importing its examples.
The game procedure provides purpose d qubzinawo and a rule about who bends next. U kibo at Jan 2.33/5465 may name that participant; the machine abstraction “his bending over” is not decisive.
Kəbli ʕal iḏe at Jan 3.1/9 is literal bending over a hand; kissing is not expressed. It does not support another idiom. The round-1 shame collocation remains in the baseline.
The active Preterit cell already has five examples after round 1; Jan’s routine active Preterit tokens are not added.
Check 95/246 makəb against edition/speaker before admitting a III stem; a single m-initial intransitive token does not establish its base forms.
Are kyb and kyf dialect variants or distinct historical roots? The evidence does not decide.
Confirm conventionality of the shame collocation; the kyb addition is singly attested, with a kyf parallel at 107/19.
Confirm the vocalism and Detransitive Part. Pass. status of kibo versus active or lexical adjective status; only the bent-state use is proposed.
Does u kibo at Jan 2.33/5465 denote the person who bends in the game or the bending state?
Are kab wo and kiyab wo phonological variants of the Infectum-wa, and does their separation reflect the speaker or transcription?
Contents such as grain can be the tipped object, beside the inherited tipped jug.
Animal agents perform the same bending posture; l-marked agent and l-direction occur without an overt body-part object.
